{{EventObtain|date=26th of January 2020|event=[[Christmas 2019 Event]]}} {{For|the [[Rocking Chair]]}} {{EmoteInfobox |image1 = |-|Icon = [[File:Lazy_Couch.png]] |-|Animation = [[File:LazyCouchEmote.gif]] |cost = [[Event Store|Gift of Joy]] |creator = ''R15'' - MRePotatoes
''R6'' - BelowNatural |rarity = {{Color|Common}} |looped = Yes |music = No |moveable = No |interactable = No }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|The best way to get into the Holiday spirit!|Inventory Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Lazy Couch''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that could have been obtained through the [[Event Store|Gift of Joy]], which cost {{Tickets|1,500}} or {{Robux|150}}. It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/16983447/profile BelowNatural]. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote, though sound effects can be heard while drinking hot chocolate and eating the gingerbread. You cannot move while performing this emote. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Animations}} Lazy_Couch.gif|First version (24 December 2019 – 29 October 2020) }} ==Trivia== *This is the first event [[Emotes|emote]] to be added to the game. *A gingerbread cookie, similar to the enemy [[Gingerbread (Village of Despair)|Gingerbread]] that appears in the [[Village of Despair]], is seen being eaten while this emote is being performed. *This emote is similar to the [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Luxury_Lounge Luxury Lounge] taunt from ''Team Fortress 2''. *This [[Emotes|emote]], along with the [[Firework]], [[Frozen (Emote)|Frozen]], [[Raw Dinner]], [[Recliner]] and [[Axe Throw]] emotes, are the only emotes to play global sounds. ==Update History== *'''24 December 2019''' - [[Release v1.5|Release v1.5.0]] **'''Lazy Couch''' added. *'''26 January 2020''' - [[Release v1.6|Release v1.6.1]] **'''Lazy Couch''' is no longer obtainable. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **Animation replaced. **Sound effects added. *'''12 November 2023''' - [[v1.9.0]]l **{{Bug}} Gingerbread man does not appear. *'''2 October 2024''' - [[v1.34.0]] **{{Bug}} '''Lazy Couch''' randomly becomes slightly tilted. *'''9 October 2024''' - [[v1.35.0]] **{{Bugfix}} '''Lazy Couch''' no longer becomes slightly tilted in the lobby. *'''16 October 2024 -''' [[v1.36.0]] **{{Bugfix}} Gingerbread man now appears. {{EmoteNavBox}}
